# SCI-NOI v0.1 r0.3 Engineering Conformance Specification

Document identity: `SCI-NOI_ENGINEERING_CONFORMANCE v0.1/draft-r0.3`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Status: implementation-blind Stage B draft; not frozen.

Normative authority: the six ordered modules in
`SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_MODULE_BINDING v0.1/r0.3`, binding-file SHA-256
`b7756dbeeace639e4ec86878466fb2afcc20fe5b8d256b48b6747bff1527e03c`.
This ECS supplies prospective evidence procedure only and authors no science.

# 1. Evidence identity

Every result shall identify exact product, method, parent, observation, TolTEC
array, plan, generation, lifecycle, and named use. Review compares serialized
scientific identities and typed states, never filenames, shapes, generic flags,
approximate WCS, or undocumented defaults.

# 2. Ordinary operator and MAP-parent evidence

Evidence shall expose retained PTC occurrence, detector/network, coefficient
family/value/QC, projection contribution, unsigned denominator, numerical
`coverage_cut`, WCS/support, response, assignment, and application count. It
shall demonstrate one sign occurrence only on `Z_i^PTC` and no changed MAP
gate. A required response companion shall use identical membership and sign
exactly once.

The all-`+1` arithmetic shall be compared only to an independently governed,
scientifically realized ordinary SCI-MAP product. Missing coefficient,
`coverage_cut`, MAP admission, or other parent shall make `m_MAP` and dependent
STD evidence unavailable.

# 3. Universal design evidence

Every design record shall include exact law or finite measure; stable
population/order; alphabet; probabilities/weights; equality, duplicate,
complement, and equivalence relations; all counts; applicable ranks/null
spaces; deterministic reconstruction; lifecycle, generation, completion, and
failure; and preregistration of every applicable field. Unused fields shall be
`not_applicable`.

No review shall require every possible design to have an RNG, seed, tolerance,
retry cap, or rejected-candidate counter. Those fields apply only to a selected
stochastic rejection family.

# 4. Selected rejection-design evidence

Evidence shall enumerate the complete and active populations, zero-mass facts,
zero-total `not_applicable` strata, unavailable ambiguous positive-mass
membership, and unavailable singleton active strata. It shall reproduce exact
`tau_h`, independent symmetric base candidates, first-accepted search,
positive cap, fail-closed exhaustion, with-replacement draws, separate exact
duplicate/orbit relations, equal `1/N_resolved` weights, uncentered `r_sign`,
and content-bound scheduling-independent generator/key identity.

An exact enumeration or analytic proof shall establish conditional uniformity:
for each admitted vector `x`, the probability that trial `k` is the first
accepted vector and equals `x` is `(1-q)^(k-1) p`, where common candidate
probability `p` is identical for every admitted vector and `q` is total
admission probability. Summing `k=1..cap` supplies the same factor for every
`x`; normalization over admitted vectors is uniform. The cap affects only
resolution probability.

# 5. Completion, retry, and persistence evidence

Evidence shall distinguish rejected candidates, admitted-member failure,
scientific replacement, and idempotent execution retry. All six counts shall
reconcile; every admitted member shall complete before UNC admission. A retry
retaining scientific identity shall prove identical work and distinct
`I_attempt`. Persistence evidence shall prove the selected mode's exact
reconstruction, regeneration, sufficiency, lost questions, lifecycle,
completion, and failure semantics.

# 6. UNC evidence

Evidence shall reproduce the equal-weight known-zero-center second moment on
one exact common all-member domain without mean subtraction or `B-1`. It shall
use the exact primary product name and separately state equality to target-law
marginal variance. Counts, uniqueness, `r_sign`, `r_map`, effective
information, and estimator uncertainty shall remain separate. Source and
deterministic-residual imprint and every prohibited interpretation shall be
visible.

# 7. Reciprocal and STD evidence

No reciprocal ordinary-base evidence is presently evaluable. A future route
requires exact owner disposition, finite-positive parent domain, separate
method/profile/use, and no role promotion.

STD evidence shall bind independently realized `m_MAP` and compatible
`sigma_cond`, reproduce `zeta_cond`, verify unit `1`, and emit only the bounded
claim. It shall show no interpolation, extension, implicit reciprocal, JINC
substitution, or significance language.

# 8. Profiles, transforms, and review result

Evidence shall preserve request, applicability, eligibility, and realization
as separate fields. Existing r0.18 profiles and Registry objects remain
immutable. Changed r0.3 evaluation is unavailable until exact approved/bound
successors exist. External transform/Wiener/FRUIT evidence shall bind exact
external authority and new generations for any learning or replay.

`REQUIREMENT_PREDICTION_TRACEABILITY.csv` supplies one row per stable
requirement with owner decision, exact source digest, dependency, and parity.
A future review reports pass, fail, unavailable, or not applicable for every
row. This draft supplies no current conformance, validation, performance,
readiness, freeze, or production result.
